$comment: TEST FIXTURE — valid, and the counterpart to the two relaxing fixtures. Raises the inherited endpointRoles minimum from 2 to 3, which is a tightening and is permitted, and narrows the accepted interface types. The validator must accept it and record the tightening as a composition note, so that the check added by decision 0013 is shown to reject relaxations without also rejecting the extensions the mechanism exists for.
title: Tightening a constraint (test fixture)

objective.consumer: A fixture, standing in for a consumer.
objective.decision: Whether the validator holds the monotonicity guarantee for constraints.

overrides.note: A rail interface has at least three declared endpoint roles.
